arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Finish ONE scene as warm polished editorial watercolor/gouache. First image drawn composition only; second image BODY FINISH ONLY. Original photos following control canine identity. Smooth short coat planes and smooth contours on BOTH dogs; NO engraved, curled, hatched strands on torsos/neck/haunch. Fine hair only Buddy regional ears muzzle brows and paws. Buddy full moderately elongated torso, substantial legs, neck, clearance, pale muzzle/brows, dark eye surrounds, tan chest fields and pale feet. His tail predominantly dark narrow taper, NO white tip or thick plume. Neet golden smooth full narrow torso fine legs, broad triangular ears, tan unstriped forehead, cream muzzle bib, tiny nearflush nub NO long tail. Preserve anatomically connected supported bodies and distinct limbs. No lettering, symbols, frame, logos. N35 excludes anatomy, B08 styling only, B25 unavailable, B30 not used; original exposure counts once. Human likeness provisional. Render TOP panel of first reference as one independent landscape scene. Buddy's chin is on blanket foreground, sleepy self-important eyes; basset left and pug right on own mats, Labrador nurse in simple unmarked white cap and terrier behind. No Neet or Heather. Close low angle, all on floor. Keep Buddy anatomy supported, no tooth visible in closed mouth.
